review_method: Git source diffs and surrounding source only; no srcMove outputs consulted. One AI reviewer, no human or second blind adjudicator. Inclusion scope is recognized C/C++ changed paths. Whole standalone typedefs/functions/classes/structs are primary units; descendants carried inside edited extraction parents do not become independent positives.
targeted_search_method: First 20 first-parent commits starting at anchor~30 whose full commit message matches case-insensitive extended regexp move|refactor|extract. Initial accidental --skip=30 metadata-only log query was not used for diff selection. All 20 selected diffs were screened; complex cases explicitly incomplete.
endpoint_hash_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source lines start_line..end_line inclusive, preserving line endings and indentation, including terminal newline when present.
limitations: No confirmed Type2 positive in this OpenCV sample; target quota unmet.
Four ordinary revisions have incomplete/unresolved source review and cannot supply exhaustive recall or clean-negative claims.
Targeted selection dominated by correlated IPP extraction campaign; no population accuracy claim.
Source-screened nonselected targeted revisions are search records, not complete negative oracles.
Type1 ordinal swap has one event by declared convention; reciprocal swap is not another positive.
